request.title: Document searching by tag
request.description: Add a short section on tag search to the usage guide.

steps.content:
# Using Lumen Notes

Create a note, tag it, and search by tag.

## Searching by tag

Type `tag:` followed by the tag name, for example `tag:recipes`.
